answer.value: Pre-training uses large-scale text and multimodal corpora; SFT data includes instruction-following data from InternVL3, multimodal reasoning data in "Thinking" mode (covering expert domains such as mathematics and scientific disciplines), and capability-expansion datasets (e.g., GUI-based interaction, embodied interaction). Card metadata lists language as multilingual.
quotes: During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
(1) Instruction-following data from InternVL3, which are reused to preserve broad coverage of vision–language tasks.
The questions in these datasets cover various expert domains, such as mathematics and scientific disciplines, thereby strengthening performance on different reasoning tasks.
